emergence.summary: A dominantly inherited tumour-predisposition syndrome caused by loss-of-function of an E3-ubiquitin-ligase substrate-recognition BRAKE on the hypoxia response. The VHL protein (pVHL) is the substrate-recognition subunit of an E3 ligase (with elongin B/C, cullin-2, Rbx1) that, under normal oxygen, binds the prolyl-hydroxylated hypoxia-inducible factor alpha subunits (chiefly HIF-2alpha / EPAS1, also HIF-1alpha) and targets them for proteasomal degradation -- the BRAKE that keeps the pseudohypoxic transcriptional programme OFF when oxygen is plentiful. Germline LOF of one VHL allele plus somatic second-hit loss disables that recognition -> HIF-2alpha is no longer degraded under normoxia -> it accumulates, dimerises with HIF-1beta/ARNT and drives a constitutive pseudohypoxic transcriptional output (VEGF, PDGF, EPO, GLUT1, TGF-alpha) -> highly vascular tumours: retinal and CNS haemangioblastomas, clear-cell renal cell carcinoma, phaeochromocytoma/paraganglioma, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours and cysts, endolymphatic-sac tumours. Read as a released BRAKE on the HIF response (pVHL degrades HIF-2alpha; LOF releases it -> HIF-2alpha drive UP) -- the released-brake -> over-activation convention, but here the released species is a STABILISED TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR, opening a NEW HYPOXIA-SENSING (HIF) axis and the brake-loss -> TF-stabilisation contrast to the kit's metabolite/enzyme/transport released-brake reads. The kit re-derives the targeted approved arm -- RESTRAIN the stabilised driver with the HIF-2alpha inhibitor belzutifan (Welireg, FDA 2021 for VHL-associated tumours not requiring immediate surgery), which blocks HIF-2alpha/ARNT dimerisation and so lowers the pseudohypoxic output even though pVHL recognition remains lost (the downstream-driver restraint logic). Belzutifan is a systemic option for tumours that previously required repeated surgery; it modifies the disease, is not curative, and resistance/residual disease occur (recorded honestly). The gamma reads the VHL locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesions are missense/truncating/deletion two-hit events outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: HIF-2alpha-driven pseudohypoxic transcriptional output (angiogenic / proliferative tumour drive) -- a hypoxia-sensing (HIF) axis; the brake-loss -> transcription-factor-stabilisation contrast to the kit's other released-brake (metabolite/transport) reads

per_gene.note: VHL encodes pVHL, the substrate-recognition subunit of a cullin-2 E3 ubiquitin ligase that binds prolyl-hydroxylated HIF-alpha (HIF-2alpha/EPAS1, HIF-1alpha) under normoxia and marks it for proteasomal degradation -- the BRAKE on the hypoxia-inducible transcriptional programme. Two-hit (germline + somatic) LOF removes that recognition -> HIF-2alpha is stabilised and the pseudohypoxic drive runs constitutively (axis UP). 3p25.3, OMIM 608537; VHL disease OMIM 193300. NCBI official symbol VHL. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the coding/deletion lesions are outside the promoter firewall.
per_gene.src: Latif 1993 Science 260:1317 (VHL gene identified); Maxwell 1999 Nature 399:271 (pVHL targets HIF-alpha for oxygen-dependent degradation)

falsifiers.claim: VHL LOF (released HIF-degradation brake) raises HIF-2alpha-driven pseudohypoxic output (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: a VHL LOF allele that LOWERED normoxic HIF-2alpha protein / HIF-target transcription (VEGF, GLUT1, CA9) would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: normoxic HIF-2alpha protein level and HIF-target gene expression (VEGF, CA9, GLUT1) in VHL-null vs VHL-reconstituted clear-cell RCC cells

falsifiers.claim: restraining HIF-2alpha (belzutifan) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the pseudohypoxic drive)
falsifiers.falsifier: if a HIF-2alpha inhibitor RAISED HIF-target output or GREW VHL-associated tumours, the restrain-HIF-2alpha lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: HIF-target transcription and haemangioblastoma / renal-tumour response to belzutifan in VHL
